model_reasoning: The shelves are very well-stocked and organized overall. Products are neatly arranged with clear pricing. However, minor misalignments were observed in a small section of air freshener sprays and some tea light packs on the bottom shelf, leading to a 'warning' status. The shelf fill rate is exceptionally high.
summary: Prateleira 4 da zona Z_S5 com fill rate de 97%, produtos de ambientação e velas. Problemas: ambientadores em spray desalinhados no lado esquerdo e embalagens de chás de vela desalinhadas no lado direito, ambos com severidade baixa. Quarta-feira 19h58, estado warning.
